checks.details: Correct fixture passed, injected fault failed, repaired fixture passed.

checks.reason: Reset task left pending requests active, causing an unmodeled edge transaction.

limitations: Development verification is not official evaluation.
Original text omits explicit reset contents. Implemented zero global history and weakly not-taken (01) PHT counters.
No synthesis or board verification performed.

justified_tb_changes.change: Clear predict_valid and train_valid when beginning asynchronous reset.
justified_tb_changes.justification: The reset task deasserted reset before the next rising edge while stale requests remained active; the model did not account for that intervening transaction. Clearing requests makes the reset sequence idle without changing oracle values or removing checks.

implementation.interface: Original TopModule ports and widths preserved.
implementation.cycle_semantics: Combinational prediction uses current PHT/history. Positive-edge training saturates a two-bit counter. Misprediction recovery has priority over speculative history updates. Asynchronous active-high reset.
implementation.widths: 7-bit XOR indices and history, 128 two-bit unsigned saturating counters.
implementation.latency: Combinational prediction; state updates on the next rising edge.
implementation.static_review: Single sequential driver, nonblocking register updates, bounded unsigned counter arithmetic.
